runs.scenario_id: commit accepted while a step is in flight must leave the transaction committed and immutable

test.oracle_basis_ref: packages/tx/README.md "After commit": the transaction becomes immutable and no more steps can be added; packages/tx/src/types.ts TxStatus lifecycle where committed is a terminal state

runs.expected: Either commit() called while a step is running throws TransactionStateError, or once commit() resolves the transaction stays committed: the later step failure does not execute compensations and a follow-up run() reports currentState "committed".
